description: issue #932, the EXECUTE half of the pair whose check half is `command-body-no-value-check` — the same source, so the two stages are pinned to the same answer for one program (the same `ol-no-value` code, span, and `form` param, differing only in `stage`). The runtime used to carry a verbatim copy of the checker's three-name command list, so BOTH stages were silent here: agreement on the wrong answer. The trace stops at the `instruction` event for the assignment: the body's final statement is a Command, so `runComprehensionBody` reports no-value for the first element before evaluating it, and no `move`/`draw-segment` event is ever emitted — the same order the `print` spelling follows.
